six_rivals.whole_saved_paragraph: **Rival 1: School Lunch is chiefly crisis logistics; quiet cooking is expendable evidence.** MAIN's ration demand, Final's arrival and public emergency response make logistics a substantial part of its role. The rival is strongest when a general institutional argument asks how Gehenna can operate under threat. Yet a crisis-only selection cannot explain what Fuuka refuses to lose, why Juri chooses service, why a provider wants recognition, or why a made and appreciated dish is a positive end. Soba, clothes, gardens, cookies, gifts and a day off supply those purposes. They are not decorations around capacity. The more adequate reading integrates crisis work with the ordinary lives that are served, desired and sometimes commandeered, while keeping each source's chronology distinct.

**Rival 2: Juri is incompetent and Fuuka is simply the burdened competent worker.** Repeated failures, harmful food, delayed rest and scarce equipment give this contrast genuine pressure. It becomes false when categorical: Juri's contest win, trophy, parfait, waitress service, ingredients knowledge, gardening, coordinated preparation and completed final pancakes are contrary cases. Fuuka's harmful eighteen-dish care, privacy needs, forgotten contact and proposed concealment also prevent a purity contrast. The better institutional account distinguishes tasks, criteria and recipients. It preserves uneven competence and recurrent burden without denying either worker agency, pleasure, fallibility or particular accomplishment. The unexplained good taste need not become permanent mastery to refute “nothing works.”

**Rival 3: enthusiastic participation, affection or Juri's desire makes extra service consensual.** The source has chosen work, explicit agreements, friendship language and actual assistance; an account of pure external oppression would suppress those acts. The rival fails where it extends a local choice to someone else's time or to every subsequent task. G1104 overrides a warning; E844's manager continues after inability is stated; E820's fresh request is required after an objection; MINI ends with a bound protesting cook while Juri is falsely reassured. Juri's wish to serve and Fuuka's preference for rest can both be valid. The synthesis preserves local voluntary cooperation without treating the institution as a source of endlessly available labor.

**Rival 4: favorable criteria, a prize, enjoyable eating or waking proves successful and safe provision.** G16's genuine positive checks and Juri's real awards are evidence, not mirages. The error is a change of claim. Hygiene criteria do not cover a subsequently offered drink; Izumi's enjoyment does not answer Iori's adverse response; a trophy does not validate every recipe; waking does not establish enduring health; final shared pancakes do not supply future reproducibility. The appropriate result is neither mistrusting every positive nor announcing universal safety. It states what was checked or achieved, whose result it was, and which outcome remains absent. This also prevents adverse evidence from retrospectively cancelling an actual local good meal.

**Rival 5: scarcity and anxiety excuse concealed restraint or relevant information.** Fuuka's fear of another poor result and lost funds is understandable within her work account. Familiar patterns can also make Juri's trust understandable when told Fuuka is protected. But explanation does not make concealment prudent. The inspection ends without a successful cover-up, and MINI's message does not inform Juri of the captivity. The more adequate reading treats warning, disclosure and a worker's own answer as part of institutional responsibility, while carefully distinguishing a proposed concealment from enacted removal. It cannot infer permanent deceit from that proposal, and it cannot confer assent from a belief produced by omitted facts.

**Rival 6: apology, gratitude, a rescue or a later meal settles the earlier debt.** There are actual corrections to recognize: Haruna listens, apologizes and asks; Fuuka agrees; Juri learns and gives refusal permission; the club produces appreciated food; MAIN shows public apologies and Final a successful arrival. Those endpoints broaden the relationship and institution. They do not print every return, repaired budget, restored holiday, compensated loss, worker livelihood, release or victim consultation. Nor can an unanchored later publication supply a world date. The strongest account preserves both fulfilled local repair and unresolved obligations, rather than granting blanket acquittal or saying nothing ever changes. The claim remains sensitive to exactly what each ending completes.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Gehenna's School Lunch Club, the text's `給食部`, is an institution because preparing and distributing meals entails a continuing arrangement of work, material access, timing, evaluation and responsibility to other people. Fuuka and Juri are its securely identified workers in the selected arguments. That identification does not make every visitor a member: GROUP1602 explicitly distinguishes Izumi's Gourmet affiliation from Lunch Club membership. Nor does the club name, a master-data category or a promise of assistance supply a complete constitution, procurement ledger or formal employment regime. The study asks what governance actually occurs around food, rather than treating a stated feeding purpose as proof of successful, fair or harmless provision. Its existing required home owns resources and evaluation; the separate Fuuka–Juri directed study owns their substantial reassurance, division of work and information relationship. [G16 §3/§4; G20 §6; method §7.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Institutional membership/work question; no complete constitution or proxy dyad.

Their witnesses are pinned to `electricgoat/ba-data@jp a038020f1f5ac02dcfe76962426d38f86414cdd8`, generation `BA_REFRESH_20260928T032248159554Z`, parser `0.2.0`. Inherited primary-reading assertions belong to their actual authors. The exact input and receiving receipt distinguishes fresh complete arguments, bounded complete meanings, adequate prior own scopes, attributed author custody and metadata-only routes. Hashing or copying any argument supplies no reading credit by itself.

Conversely, receipt of an adopted comparison does not make this new institution study canonical. Fuuka's nineteen and Juri's seventeen selected private objects are their admitted source envelopes, not thirty-six new source readings by this author, an institution census or a full-franchise claim. Their complete family checkpoints and comparisons were received as analytical arguments, with local language and endpoint limits intact. Current normal G20 supplies the adopted connected context. claims.body_paragraph_text: One planning label requires explicit precision. The frozen source plan calls PL10 “School Lunch MINI020/050.” The current maintained MINI argument establishes School Lunch's two complete cookie/rescue objects as `BA:mini:70006010` and `BA:mini:70006020`, §8/L166–176. `BA:mini:70002020` is a distinct club-trial/teaching comparator; its visit does not become one of those cookie objects. [MINI §3/§8; M020 P03.]

claims.body_paragraph_text: The governed institutional target is independently justified by this question. Fuuka's individual wants, Juri's learning and the Gourmet Society's differentiated pleasures remain substantial character and ensemble responsibilities. Their cooperation with School Lunch does not automatically complete any directed parent. Equally, this institution is not a proxy account of Prefect protection, Pandemonium leadership or the whole Gehenna state. Those actors enter here only where their requests, inspections, coercion, assistance or public operations alter the actual possibilities of preparing and receiving food.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Separate actual character/ensemble/directed/institution responsibilities remain uncompleted by this account.

claims.body_paragraph_text: School Lunch's recurring problem is a mismatch between the social confidence placed in feeding and the arrangements necessary to make feeding answerable. The sources show skill, effort, appetite, affection and even completed good food. They also show missing oil and equipment, unconsulted intervention, pressured cooking, blocked warning, personal hospitality beyond an inspection's criteria, harmful results and continuing work with unprinted repair. The institution works when particular people coordinate material preparation and acknowledge one another's limits. It becomes coercive or unreliable when a desire for food, a claim of rescue, a good intention or an encouraging evaluation is allowed to stand in for that coordination. This is an interpretive mechanism supported by the scenes, not a formal behavioral model or a claim that every School Lunch interaction follows one rule.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Interpretive institutional mechanism, not validated behavioral model or universal rule.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Five questions therefore remain distinct throughout the study: was food actually made; did someone want to undertake that work; what could the recipient know and refuse; what was the observed result for this recipient; and what work, damage or obligation was subsequently repaired? GROUP1104 brings oil and willing helpers without printing a finished meal. GROUP1602 passes hygiene criteria before a harmful offered drink and a later F rating. EVENT844 supplies actually eaten and appreciated pancakes after instruction and explicit permission to decline, while time pressure and institutional undervaluation remain. None is a substitute answer to all five questions. Their differences make a richer account than either “School Lunch always fails” or “sincere cooking makes everything care.” [G11 §6; G16 §5; E844 §5.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Made food/chosen work/information/result/repair are distinct endpoints.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The positive ends are intrinsic. Fuuka's soba conversation, amusement, ingredients negotiation, chosen clothes and wishes for peace do not need to improve a military operation to matter. Juri's café pleasure, gardening, trophy, unexpectedly edible parfait, desired service and renewed attempts matter without proving permanent competence. The completed cookie tasting in MINI06020 is valuable as taste and cute making even though captivity closes the encounter badly. A synthesis that retained only coercion or safety failure would erase precisely the ordinary life whose conditions the institution is supposed to support. Pleasant food is an achieved good at its printed extent; it is not evidence that an associated burden has been consented to or repaired. [F-CHK P01/P04; J-CHK R02–R04; MINI §8.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Quiet ordinary successes intrinsic; completed taste cannot authorize burden or captivity.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The institution is also larger than either worker's temperament. Fuuka's competence cannot make four thousand eggs, one pan, absent oil and a two-hour deadline a practicable arrangement merely by moral expectation. Juri's desire to feed people cannot make Fuuka permanently requisitionable, or remove the need to test and inform before serving. Consumers are neither a unanimous audience nor passive measurements: one person accepts boiled eggs, another requests the unwanted serving, another defends the promised menu; some New Year customers welcome a dish others dislike. Thus distributive responsibility includes multiple ordinary tastes and budgets, rather than a single ideal customer whose delight certifies the institution. [G11 1104:u0001–0024; E820 007/014; E844 010:scene003.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Workload quantities are reports; actual recipient differences are not an ideal universal customer.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The strongest synthesis is consequently neither a story of inevitable progress nor a permanent pathology. There are actual local revisions: a renewed request after apology, a bounded agreement, a learned cooking accomplishment, a refusal option, a decision to preserve another person's day off. There are repeated failures and contrary acts as well. Those changes can be interpreted within their sequences. Unanchored group, private and miniature stories cannot be placed after a particular apology to manufacture either reform or relapse. The repertoire is coherent through its continuing questions of work and recipient agency even where a global chronology is unavailable.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Local revisions and continuing contrary acts; no manufactured global development.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Meal provision makes Fuuka responsible to a timetable and many eaters, without giving every eater authority over her person or every kitchen action. GROUP1601 opens three hours before service. Izumi wants cookies now and offers soup as an alternative; Fuuka insists that lunch must wait for its time. The institutional issue is distribution, not proof that appetite is shameful or that soup is intrinsically unacceptable. Someone who prepares communal food must preserve its availability for other recipients. This locally asserted boundary is practical authority grounded in a task. It is not a complete legal entitlement, and the study does not need one to recognize her refusal as meaningful. [G16 1601:u0001–0028.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Local distribution refusal grounded in task; no complete legal entitlement.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Juri is a working participant rather than an interchangeable deficit in Fuuka's capacity. She helps with capture and calming, knows ingredients and order, wants to teach visitors, values serving, fetches vegetables and asks about potato preparation. Some of those acts are successful and some belong to interrupted or failed cooking. EVENT844's later Fuuka statement that School Lunch cannot operate without Juri recognizes operational dependence; Juri hears both appreciation and a painful implication about her cooking role. Their differentiated labor is therefore visible without pretending that every division is agreed, measured or settled. The institution must preserve the contribution of practical assistance alongside the person's wish to make food herself. [G16 §4; M020 P03; J-CHK R04; E844 010:scene002–003.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Practical contributions and wanted cooking differ; no agreed/measured final labor division.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Consumers have their own responsibilities and rights. Izumi's delight in juice does not make her a qualified assessor of its effect on Iori. Haruna's menu complaint can be a legitimate stated expectation while her ensuing kitchen interference disregards the provider's warning. Junko's willingness to help does not guarantee coordinated help. Haruna's useful oil and Akari's appeal to friendship do not resolve who may move what at the stove. Describing these differences avoids giving either cooks or customers a monopoly on the meaning of food. Good taste, promised menus, hunger, preparation conditions and actual recipient safety must be negotiated in the same social space, although they remain different tests. [G11 §6; G16 §5.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Different consumer/help acts; no pleasure-as-general-safety or supplanted provider control.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Iori is a substituted evaluator in GROUP1601–1602. Her threatening entrance pressures the workers, while her subsequent checklist response genuinely recognizes the clean hands, equipment, furniture and ingredients presented. The task she states is checking hygiene, not inventing faults. That local fairness matters, and Juri explicitly praises it. It does not establish the full mandate of substituted inspectors or a scientific food-safety audit. The later incident supplies new evidence and a new rating. Institutional authority here is situated and revisable; neither her first menace nor her first praise exhausts it. [G16 1601:u0041–0073;1602:u0001–0059/u0092.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actual favorable checks and later rating; no scientific audit/full inspector mandate.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Helpers and outside employers create another asymmetry. The café manager can praise Juri's service and propose permanent work, which she declines, yet later pressure her to cook after the chef's separate accident despite her stated inability. Offering to bring Fuuka for higher pay does not solve that pressure or authorize it. Juri elects to try partly to protect Fuuka's rest, making the act meaningful without making its conditions uncomplicated freedom. Likewise, a Gourmet rescue project can listen to a proprietor and later ask Fuuka properly while beginning with her capture. The institution's question is who can turn a request into another person's obligation, not whether the requesting actor ever has a generous motive. [E844 001:scene002–004; E820 002/003/012.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Manager and Gourmet pressure coexist with praise/generous motives; no retroactive consent.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Sensei's role varies. No teacher participates in G16's inspection, so the adults' absence cannot be filled with an imagined regulating lesson. Gift039 shows an invited shared table and gratitude; gift040 shows emotional validation alongside dismissed risk and a harmful local result. EVENT844 includes encouragement of rest, objection to patient treatment and temporary operational command, followed by accepted food after an explicit refusal permission. MAIN shows both confinement and later coalition work. These are different relations to institutional authority; one warm adult encounter cannot make the cooks' labor generally available or resolve another consumer's uninformed position. [G16 §6; gifts039/040; E844 §4/§5; MAIN C002.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Adult roles vary; no unprinted teacher presence or standing labor authorization.

claims.body_paragraph_text: GROUP1104 makes resource limits a voiced account, not mere scenery. Fuuka says she cannot fry four thousand eggs alone in two hours; Juri is absent, oil is unavailable and there is one pan. Those quantities and shortages are her reports, not independently audited inventories. Their narrative force is nevertheless clear: a menu expectation meets an arrangement the responsible worker describes as impossible. Haruna anticipates the problem and brings actual oil; the friends volunteer actual help. The ingredients and intentions change, but the institutional relation fails at Fuuka's interrupted warning to ask before touching. This is why resource supplementation cannot be equated with a completed remedy. [G11 1104:u0009–0024.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Reported eggs/time/pan/absence/oil, actual oil/help, interrupted warning; supplementation not remedy.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The ending is a work outcome in its own right. Oil, eggs, flour, falls and crashes leave the kitchen in disorder and Fuuka silent. Exact intermediate choreography is uncertain; no particular injury, intention to attack or completed restitution should be invented. What is absent is equally specific: no prepared replacement meal, cleanup, apology, cost assessment or repaired work arrangement is printed. Silence supports the interrupted conclusion, not a diagnosis or a permanent attitude to the Society. The act of volunteering may be sincere. Its failure demonstrates how the provider's practical knowledge can be overridden by help that never gives her effective control over its execution. [G11 1104:u0025–0049; §8/§9.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actual disordered ending and silence; no invented injury/cleanup/apology/restitution/diagnosis.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The club-trial MINI02020 gives a parallel constraint at a different scope. Fuuka discusses dinner preparation and the missing food truck. Juri offers a tour and instruction; curiosity and hospitality are real, but the unusual omelette and retreat interrupt the lesson. Japanese thousands of portions and Korean a few thousand each day remain distinct reported quantities. No repaired truck, completed edible meal, successful training program or general relief follows. This episode matters because teaching is a wanted institutional function, rather than merely spare capacity: visitors and workers have reasons to value learning even when the setting prevents it. [M020 P03; current MINI §3.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Separate teaching/truck comparator; locale quantities distinct, no completed meal/training/repair.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT820 widens resource responsibility from the cafeteria to a threatened restaurant and suppliers. The proprietor describes franchise prices, rent and inherited place; merchants refuse or explain stock; company personnel speak of job dependence and handling food. These are situated testimonies. They support a conflict over material access and livelihoods without an audited contract, stock census or payroll record. Fuuka's demonstrated preparation knowledge and Juri's ingredient interest operate within those constraints. Affordable menu proposals revise Haruna's initial neglect of price, while customers' budgets remain actual local preferences, not a statistical population. [E820 003/004/007–009.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Situated stock/employment/rent testimony and actual preferences; not audited payroll/contract/census.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The contest provides real work and a finite win without a full resource settlement. Fuuka initially objects to forced participation, then Haruna apologizes and asks again; Fuuka agrees. Reported damaged vegetables, meat, bottles and deliveries qualify supply success. Japanese less-than-half usable vegetables differs from Korean about one third. Particular preparations are done—Japanese pickling is complete where Korean drying is current, and shrimp and carrots have their own endpoints. The announced hundred boxes and four hundred servings, as well as Juri's daily-volume figure, remain attributed statements rather than certified output capacity. Announced victory and thanks do not print paid overtime, continued employment, final ownership or every supplier remedy. [E820 012–014.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Renewed request/agreement, reported supply/deliveries, actual finite win; no durable resource settlement.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT844 likewise refuses a simple equation between accomplishment and relief. A rare day off is interrupted; after several days School Lunch is again preparing food and receives varied household-style complaints. Fuuka states that time and recognition remain insufficient. Juri's actual shared pancakes supply a local success, not a staffing increase or a recovered holiday. Recognition can be necessary without being adequate: appreciation does not itself redistribute work, provide equipment, pay a worker, or complete the time someone lost. The study does not infer that compensation is impossible; it records that these sources do not show it. [E844 001/002/010.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actual shared food with continuing time/recognition constraint; no staffing increase/recovered holiday.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The military and emergency comparators sharpen this limit. In MAIN C002, Fuuka refuses an impossible three-day whole-school ration demand and plans to slow supply; reported power does not turn infeasibility into competence. In Final C004 E003–004, her pressured driving contributes to an actual arrival. Successful public action demonstrates a particular role, while the argument explicitly preserves the original boarding's lack of retrospective consent. No kitchen capacity, general future vehicle availability or labor settlement follows from the terminal operation's success. These episodes show institutional usefulness under pressure, not the exhaustion of the worker's independent purposes. [MAIN C002 E011–015 checkpoint; Final004:003:u0053–0064/004:u0011–0013.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Ration refusal and actual pressured driving/arrival; no retrospective boarding consent.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Fuuka's private repertoire constrains an institutional interpretation from within. The produce negotiation ends in buying and returning ingredients; an arrangement for later remains conditional. Soba eating and quiet conversation, clothing nerves, amusement, home accompaniment and wishes for peace are positively represented parts of her life. Her practical care does not require every pleasure to be a recovery technique or an efficiency investment. A provider can want food, time and company as a recipient. The institution's feeding purpose would be impoverished if the cook's own enjoyment were treated as irrelevant whenever it does not change public throughput. [F-CHK P01/P04; F-CMP Q01.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Ordinary private recipient ends intrinsic; future arrangement conditional.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Her limitations are equally ordinary and meaningful. An invitation can be qualified by fatigue; a not-teasing request and a confidentiality request retain their own authority. A replacement joke is refused; later compliance with secrecy is unprinted. Care improves locally when it asks the recipient's preferences, without becoming a promise of daily service. Written holiday or shop lines remain contextual possibilities, not a calendar of fulfilled outings. Clothes, hair, embarrassment and desired company do not warrant an involuntary public image or a settled romance. They show that chosen presentation and reception belong in the account of a worker who is often treated chiefly as a needed cook. [F-CMP Q03/Q04; F-CHK P03–P06.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actual secrecy/privacy/refusal/fatigue; no performed outings/public image/settled romance.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Juri's pleasure is not cancelled by repeated failure. A café order and conversation give enjoyment and recipe curiosity. Her actual contest win, trophy and shared return oppose a blanket incapacity claim; actual eating and appraisal of a parfait oppose the idea that no food she makes ever works. The award is a represented organizer result, not a tested general algorithm or professional ranking. An unexplained successful taste is real without explaining why every other attempt failed. Desire to learn, embarrassment about publicity, customer-violence refusal, a part-time uniform, garden pleasure, particular hand warmth and invitations have value whether or not they produce institutional reform. [J-CHK R02/R03; J-CMP Q01/Q02/Q04.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Real trophy/parfait/service/gardening qualify blanket incapacity; no recipe algorithm/professional rank.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Gardening is a modest practical and wanted activity, not a departure from cooking. Juri's supply and budget accounts, sun-care preparation, Fuuka's encouragement and locally useful cultivation broaden what a participant can contribute. The later wait and tentative or withdrawn explanation do not certify illness, a cure, a permanent disappearance or abandoned cooking. Her future weaker-sun invitation remains future. This is a serious contrary case to the assertion that only culinary success can give her a place in School Lunch. It is not sufficient evidence that cultivation solves the club's procurement problem or gives her independent control of its budget. [J-CHK R04/R05; J-CMP Q05.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Garden contribution and wanted activity; no established illness/cure/disappearance/abandoned cooking.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT844 turns ordinary choices into the event's first substantive asymmetry: Fuuka values a day free from service, while Juri chooses service because it resembles the happiness of people enjoying her cooking. Fuuka first suggests rest, then supports Juri's different preference; Juri wants Fuuka's free day protected. They do not have to want the same activity to care for one another. A coerced-work-only account would lose Juri's actual choice and skill as a waitress; a work-as-love account would make Fuuka's day off disposable. The sources make both goods intelligible before the accident, and the interruption does not retrospectively make either preference a mistake. [E844 001:scene001–002.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Different rest/service preferences valid; chosen service does not make provider rest disposable.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Gifts039 and040 keep private making and reception distinct from payment for service. Fuuka chooses to bring a meal, accepts shared eating, offers handmade cocoa and receives a narrated warm response. She denies special intention in matched cups; storage, container return and hoped-for sleep are not printed outcomes. Juri's first tasty chocolate is bought, while a handmade batch is withheld because she reports earlier tasters collapsing. The fallback preserves agency and a wish to give without harming. Adult validation and eventual tasting lead to fading consciousness, so emotional appreciation is neither meaningless nor a safety certificate. A gift cannot purchase the giver's subsequent labor or make every recipient objection void. [gift039:u0031–0052; gift040:scene002:u0005–0034; current E810 §6.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Gift provenance/choice and actual adverse ending; pleasure/appreciation not safety or purchased labor.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Finally, wanted food is plural. Junko's successful New Year meal, Akari's boiled-egg preference, a visitor's price limit, ordinary menu complaints, Mine's cute-cookie pleasure and Fuuka's desire to help hungry people across schools all matter. They cannot be collapsed into a single superior taste. In MINI06020, food and cute craft achieve pleasure before the final restraint. Keeping that accomplishment and the adverse ending together protects ordinary evidence from both utility reduction and sentimental acquittal. The cook's own stated wish to make cookies is also a reason to postpone another lunch request, not evidence that all cooking can be demanded on the same schedule. [G11 §6; E820 001/007; E844 010; MINI §8.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Plural ordinary wants, achieved cookies and adverse control ending remain together.

claims.body_paragraph_text: G16's ordered inspection is the clearest test of institutional evaluation. Fuuka reports that a previous apparently pleasant inspection led to poor marks and a halved budget. Juri tries to reassure her; a remembered smile does not constitute a favorable report. Iori reports a former inspector's poisoning diagnosis and possible pathogens; those remain reports and possibilities. Fuuka's distinction between poor taste and negligent hygiene is therefore an argument about criteria, not an already established universal safety claim. A frightening entrance can coexist with later evidence-based concession. [G16 1601:u0029–0073.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Reported previous diagnosis/budget versus actual current criteria; not a universal safe-food claim.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The present checks genuinely favor the club. Hands, tools, furniture and ingredients receive favorable marks. Iori's explicit distinction between hygiene and bad taste prevents interpreting the later F as proof that every earlier compliment was dishonest. A moving dish is represented, but Juri's autonomous-selfhood explanation is untested; Iori asks whether that phenomenon belongs under hygiene. The source does not settle ingredient causes, a completed fight or a new person ontology. It instead exposes how a local evaluation domain can omit a risk which the participants do not know how to classify. [G16 1602:u0001–0057.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Real favorable checks, moving food and untested selfhood; no new person/medical mechanism.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Personal hospitality then changes the evidence. Fuuka offers water when Iori is thirsty. Juri provides fresh fruit juice, identified as the same welcome offered to the earlier inspector rather than ordered stock already inspected. Fuuka recalls the earlier diagnosis and tries to stop consumption; Iori has drunk and reacts adversely. Juri calls the unresponsiveness sleep. The sequence strongly supports a source-local explanation of the present incident, while the repeated diagnosis line in Fuuka's realization is not a newly verified medical report. Clinical chemistry, enduring injury and a general pathology remain unestablished. [G16 1602:u0061–0083, attribution table.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Personal drink outside checklist and actual harmful reaction; recalled diagnosis not second confirmation.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Two contrary reactions must survive: Izumi drinks and enjoys the juice, and Iori later safely awakens and gives an F. Enjoyment is her own positive experience; it does not answer what happened to Iori or prove immunity. Waking is narrated; clinical clearance is absent. The grade is actual; another budget halving is Fuuka's fear rather than printed implementation. These distinctions make evaluation responsive to new evidence without treating every judgment as infallible. They also show why a worker may genuinely protect hygiene and nonetheless contemplate a profoundly inadequate response to a harmed guest. [G16 1602:u0084–0092.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Izumi enjoyment/Iori waking/F are source-specific; budget reduction is feared, not implemented.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Fuuka's proposed concealment belongs in the institutional argument precisely because she is ordinarily competent and concerned. Fear of another F and lost funds makes the temptation intelligible; it does not justify withholding a victim or make the proposed removal prudent. The source prints an alarming suggestion and then says no solution worked. It does not print disappearance, killing, successful concealment or a coordinated cover-up. The serious inference is that evaluation pressure can make protecting the institution's apparent standing compete with answering to the affected person. That explanatory relation remains an interpretation of the local sequence, not a diagnosis or proof of an academy-wide incentive mechanism. [G16 §5/§7.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Proposed concealment under fear, no successful removal or killing; local interpretation not academy-wide measured incentive.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Private care provides additional limits on success language. Fuuka's eighteen-dish effort has Japanese eating versus Korean tasting all eighteen, an adverse endpoint and an actual prescription; provision, administration, ingestion and cure are not printed. Eel purchase and return differ from later whole-thread testimony about today's dish, preparation and improved stamina. Juri's medicine is contemplated rather than prescribed, and repeated soup attempts leave the final dish unresolved. These cases qualify a competence-only account without equating all Fuuka care with Juri failure. The institutional synthesis uses them to distinguish a made dish, a reported effect, a proposed remedy and a completed recipient result. [F-CHK P02/P03; F-CMP Q05; J-CHK R01; J-CMP Q03.]
literal_in_body_evidence_strings: F-CHK P02/P03; F-CMP Q05; J-CHK R01; J-CMP Q03.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Eating/tasting and prescription versus medicine/cure, reports versus witnessed cooking, soup unfinished.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT844 supplies an especially important positive countercase. Delicious pancakes and Juri's happiness occur before the dangerous movement, so later harm cannot rewrite the earlier tasting as imaginary. The ending supplies new instruction and practice as reports, followed by explicitly permitted refusal, acceptance and narrated shared eating. This is stronger than another unfinished offer. It supports a bounded accomplishment and affection, while no controlled test of long-term reproducibility or universal harmlessness follows. To preserve both failures and actual good food is a requirement of fair institutional judgment, not a compromise made to protect a likable character. [E844 002:scene001;010:scene003:u0027–0047.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Pancakes really good/eaten, refusal permission and completed later sharing; no future reproducibility guarantee.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Longitudinal interpretation proceeds through demonstrated sequences. GROUP1601 leads directly into1602's assessment and incident. GROUP1101–1102 have their own truffle continuation, while1103 and1104 remain independently placed. The political MAIN chapters are internally ordered. EVENT820's fifteen objects and EVENT844's ten objects each have a coherent local sequence; EVENT844 explicitly moves several days forward before its closing meal. MINI06010–06020 supplies an immediate present encounter, a retrospective origin and a later cooking/chase ending. None of those orders gives all private variants or gift encounters a position on one story-world calendar. [G11 §3/§4; G16 §3; E820 local sequence; E844 §5; MINI §8.]
literal_in_body_evidence_strings: G11 §3/§4; G16 §3; E820 local sequence; E844 §5; MINI §8.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Printed local orders only; no variant/release/gift/global calendar.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT820's revision is consequently real and limited. Fuuka's holiday is interrupted and she objects to capture. Hearing the proprietor prompts her personal help offer. Later forced-contest pressure is challenged, Haruna apologizes and asks again, and Fuuka agrees. These are distinct choices, not a single retrospective yes to recruitment. Work, reported preparations, tasting and the announced win follow, then local festival hospitality and continuing comic failure. The festival's thanks do not print a business audit, every worker's livelihood, durable relief or universal consent. Listening changes a particular relation; it does not cancel its adverse beginning. [E820 002/003/012–015.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actual listening/apology/new agreement/win; no total livelihood/business audit/standing consent.

claims.body_paragraph_text: EVENT844 offers another real local trajectory. Juri's voluntarily chosen waitressing is pressured toward cooking after someone else's burner accident. Good food is actually enjoyed before harm; attempts at response include patient objections, fatigue, failed authority transfer and eventually coordinated action. Fuuka disposes of the remaining creature; after several days ordinary meal work continues, with insufficient time still voiced. The final pancakes are offered with a clear right to refuse and are eaten together. That locally learned and recipient-responsive ending is not a completed restored holiday, compensated café loss, repaired city or all-person recovery. [E844 §1–§5.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Separate accident, pressures, failure, instruction and complete shared food; not city/holiday/all-person repair.

claims.body_paragraph_text: MINI06020 refuses to end at the delicious cookies. Fuuka and Mine have an ordinary affinity in choosing supplies and a wanted cross-school feeding/care purpose. The baking is completed and the results are eaten and praised. At the end Fuuka is bound and protests while others remain absorbed in tasting; a telephone reassurance lets Juri trust a protection story without knowing the restraint. Mine pursues and narration confirms a tremendous chase, while release, returned lunch, repaired wall and solved reputation are unprinted. The positive baking result and the negative control/information result are simultaneous responsibilities of the synthesis. An ending cannot be truncated when its contrary case is inconvenient. [MINI06020:scene002:u0032–0077/scene003:u0010–0090.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Whole cookie/chase ending retained; completed food coexists with captivity and hidden information.

claims.body_paragraph_text: MAIN C002 closes the NK Ultra incident locally and records apologies, but property returns, victim consultation, discipline and joint inspection remain work. Haruna/Akari's apology for coerced food control and Fuuka/Izumi's boundaries matter; they cannot date the other episodes as regressions or erase their different recipients. Final's actual arrival and completed operation similarly establish a bounded public contribution without settling the earlier conditions under which Fuuka boarded. A “later rescue fixes earlier extraction” account would conflate separate source orders, acts and debts. [MAIN C002 E019–E021 checkpoint; Final C004 E003/E004.]
literal_in_body_evidence_strings: MAIN C002 E019–E021 checkpoint; Final C004 E003/E004.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Chapter apology and final arrival bounded; no missing property returns or victim consultation.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The outcome vocabulary matters. An actual meal, trophy, arranged ride, bought ingredients, named winner, narrated waking and spoken agreement are positive at their own extent. A requested visit, possible job, menu proposal, container reminder, returned-food promise, expected clinical improvement, feared budget cut or intended release is not the same kind of endpoint. An attributed report can be meaningful without being independently certified. This distinction protects ordinary fulfillment as well as restraint: saying a meal was actually eaten is warranted even when a budget remains unknown, and saying a budget is unknown must not be turned into a claim that no good food was made.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Endpoint vocabulary preserves real quiet fulfillment without converting forecasts/reports into completed results.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Instituted hospitality depends on information as well as permission. G16's personal drink lies outside what the favorable checklist actually covered. Gift040 makes Juri's prior-taster concern available to the adult before the handmade batch is accepted; that disclosure and her withholding are real protective agency, while the adult's reassurance does not prevent the adverse result. EVENT844's ending explicitly tells recipients they may refuse if afraid. These encounters have different information states and should not be flattened into either perfect informed choice or universal deception. Knowledge of a risk is not a guarantee, but suppressing relevant knowledge changes the relation to a decision. [G16 §5; gift040 §3; E844 010:scene003.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Recipient information differs by encounter; disclosed risk does not guarantee safety.

claims.body_paragraph_text: The supplier's information is equally necessary. Fuuka knows the timetable, tools and ingredients in G1104, but her warning is interrupted. Juri states her inability to the café manager, yet pressure continues. Fuuka's contest objection prompts a fresh request after apology rather than presumed availability. A genuine capacity assessment can therefore be disregarded by both well-intentioned helpers and an employer's urgency. Institutions distribute practical authority unfairly when they value a worker's result while denying her input into how it is achieved. The scenes support that interpretation at their own scopes; they do not establish the terms of every employment relation in Gehenna. [G11 §6; E844 001:scene003; E820 012.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Warning/inability/objection supply actual input; local institutional interpretation not all employment relations.

claims.body_paragraph_text: MINI's closing telephone report makes trust especially vulnerable. Juri is reassured that Fuuka is being protected while restraint is hidden. Her trust does not become informed assent to the binding; her earlier mistaken expectation that Fuuka was with the gourmets does not prove consent either. Fuuka herself forgot to contact Juri during wanted ingredients shopping, so the study retains her ordinary fallibility rather than making every misunderstanding someone else's invention. That lapse still cannot authorize captivity. The combination explains how practical dependence and familiar patterns permit a false reassuring story to stand in for the missing person's own answer. [MINI06010:u0025–0071;06020:scene003:u0064–0079.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Fuuka forgotten contact and Juri falsely reassured both retained; no assent from missing information.

claims.body_paragraph_text: This is the institutional portion of a larger directed problem. The separate Fuuka–Juri study must substantially examine how reassurance, recognition, division of labor and incomplete disclosure affect each direction. The Gourmet→Fuuka parent must weigh requests, refusals, the new agreement and ongoing labor against the consumers' particular acts. The Gourmet ensemble must preserve disagreement, inclusion and taste rather than treating all helpers as one actor. This study does not award those packages completion by mentioning their content. Its claim is narrower: resource governance needs the information those directions carry, and can fail when a familiar relationship is used as a substitute for the actual worker's answer.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Institutional use of direction information does not complete separate substantial directed/ensemble parents.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Recipient differences also prevent generosity from becoming compulsory uniformity. Mine's desired cute cookies, Haruna's interpretive praise, Izumi's unusual enjoyment, Junko's concern, Juri's serving ambition and Fuuka's rare rest do not combine into one common preference. In E820, opposing employees matter to Fuuka even while her own team pursues victory. In E844, household tastes do not settle a universal recipe. Cross-school feeding pleasure can be genuine without every visitor wanting the same food, price, treatment or company. The ethical inference is responsiveness to actual differences, not an invented universal policy the sources never print. [MINI §8; E820 013/014; E844 010.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Different tastes, rest and opposing employee concern; no universal integration policy.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Finally, gratitude is evidence of a situated response, not a standing authorization. It can recognize care, craft, support or pleasure while an invitation remains future, a container unreturned, a day off interrupted or an earlier capture unjustified. The gift endings demonstrate experienced comfort and appreciation without fixing romance; the event endings demonstrate actual food and thanks without supplying restitution. A provider need not deny warmth to retain a refusal. A consumer need not reject an appreciated meal to object to how someone was made to prepare it. This distinction makes the institution's relational life richer, not less affectionate.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Gratitude situated; no standing labor access, romance, retroconsent or completed restitution.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Written language marks these differences. `給食部` names the practical public activity; reported volume and the promised menu make labor's scale visible. G11's `友情` names the offered help, but the failed result qualifies what that label achieves. G16 contrasts hygiene, flavor, hospitality, contest and grade; a kindness vocabulary does not dissolve the transition from checked inventory to a personal drink. Juri's competitive welcome and Fuuka's inward worry are not a single communicated institutional intention. Written respect, apology, hesitation and request forms may support situated interpretation; they do not supply acted pitch, acoustic emotion or a universal persona. [G11 §8; G16 §3/§6.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Written politeness/labels/silence retain textual mode; no performed affect.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Actor and mode seams are preserved. G16 lists sixteen canonical/raw segment conflicts; unknown encounter clusters are not one stable extra person. Fuuka's parenthesized doubts are not automatically shared criticism; a repeated recalled diagnosis is not a second medical corroboration. G11's rapid kitchen sounds leave choreography incomplete. EVENT844 includes drift among Juri, manager, robot and responder labels, while its video controller is textual evidence only. MINI02020's generic narration/person-empty ending to the lesson cannot be given a secure named performed speaker by expectation. Consequential outcomes rely on the coherent local argument and clean narration rather than an invented voice attribution. [G16 §3; G11 §8; E844 §6; M020 P03.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Actor conflicts, inward states, remembered diagnosis and controller limits preserved; no invented voice.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Private-source seams matter to institutional comparison. Whole MomoTalk preserves post-Schedule apologies, criticism, reported dishes and future invitations that an interior trigger alone would lose. Same-group Answer alternatives, sequential singletons, BOND formal choices, inward `ns`, named `#na`, generic `#st` and written Talk/Think remain different structures. A desire found in private or inward material is available to the analyst, not automatically known by another worker, official or consumer. It cannot be used as tacit authorization to request labor. Nothing here certifies both delivery of alternatives or the audio of a controller. [F-CHK P05/P06; J-CHK R05/R06; G20 §8.]
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Whole-thread/Answer/BOND/inward/written structures distinct; analyst knowledge not shared permission.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Locale distinctions constrain apparently simple completion claims. Fuuka's eighteen dishes have Japanese eating versus Korean tasting; an eel-related later message is testimony rather than witnessed cooking. Juri's café alternatives and substitution ingredients differ; Japanese volume, organizer flags, final parfait contact and Korean return have their own formulations. MINI02020's Japanese thousands do not inherit Korean daily repetition. EVENT820's periodic seasoning replacement is not seasonal, destination-unspecified return is not home arrival, announced restart is not certified reopening, and Japanese completed pickling is not the same as Korean current drying. The Japanese-primary argument keeps these limits rather than averaging the editions into an invented common act. [F-CMP Q05/Q06; J-CMP Q01–Q06; M020 P03; E820 mode paragraph.]
literal_in_body_evidence_strings: F-CMP Q05/Q06; J-CMP Q01–Q06; M020 P03; E820 mode paragraph.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Locale acts/endpoints remain separate rather than averaged common act.

claims.body_paragraph_text: Comic food animation and lethal-looking response likewise retain their evidentiary levels. A moving dish is shown; selfhood is Juri's proposed explanation. Pancake restraint and distressed recipients are represented; a toxicological mechanism, new biological species, inspected injury population and permanent recovery are not. Safe waking is narrated; a painful action that wakes a victim is not validated universal treatment. Amputation threats in MINI remain threats, and its chase supplies no completed cure or release. The study interprets how danger and pleasure are negotiated in the fictional scenes while withholding clinical, legal, chemical and real-world instructional conclusions.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Represented harm/food animation and safe waking, no clinical/legal/chemical real-world instruction.

claims.body_paragraph_text: **Rival 1: School Lunch is chiefly crisis logistics; quiet cooking is expendable evidence.** MAIN's ration demand, Final's arrival and public emergency response make logistics a substantial part of its role. The rival is strongest when a general institutional argument asks how Gehenna can operate under threat. Yet a crisis-only selection cannot explain what Fuuka refuses to lose, why Juri chooses service, why a provider wants recognition, or why a made and appreciated dish is a positive end. Soba, clothes, gardens, cookies, gifts and a day off supply those purposes. They are not decorations around capacity. The more adequate reading integrates crisis work with the ordinary lives that are served, desired and sometimes commandeered, while keeping each source's chronology distinct.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Rival crisis-only integration tested against intrinsic ordinary ends.

claims.body_paragraph_text: **Rival 2: Juri is incompetent and Fuuka is simply the burdened competent worker.** Repeated failures, harmful food, delayed rest and scarce equipment give this contrast genuine pressure. It becomes false when categorical: Juri's contest win, trophy, parfait, waitress service, ingredients knowledge, gardening, coordinated preparation and completed final pancakes are contrary cases. Fuuka's harmful eighteen-dish care, privacy needs, forgotten contact and proposed concealment also prevent a purity contrast. The better institutional account distinguishes tasks, criteria and recipients. It preserves uneven competence and recurrent burden without denying either worker agency, pleasure, fallibility or particular accomplishment. The unexplained good taste need not become permanent mastery to refute “nothing works.”
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Rival categorical incompetence tested against real contrary successes and provider fallibility.

claims.body_paragraph_text: **Rival 3: enthusiastic participation, affection or Juri's desire makes extra service consensual.** The source has chosen work, explicit agreements, friendship language and actual assistance; an account of pure external oppression would suppress those acts. The rival fails where it extends a local choice to someone else's time or to every subsequent task. G1104 overrides a warning; E844's manager continues after inability is stated; E820's fresh request is required after an objection; MINI ends with a bound protesting cook while Juri is falsely reassured. Juri's wish to serve and Fuuka's preference for rest can both be valid. The synthesis preserves local voluntary cooperation without treating the institution as a source of endlessly available labor.
claims.remaining_warrant_or_contrary_boundary: Rival infinite consensual service tested against warning/refusal/rest/hidden restraint.

## 2. Whole literary institutional thesis

School Lunch's recurring problem is a mismatch between the social confidence placed in feeding and the arrangements necessary to make feeding answerable. The sources show skill, effort, appetite, affection and even completed good food. They also show missing oil and equipment, unconsulted intervention, pressured cooking, blocked warning, personal hospitality beyond an inspection's criteria, harmful results and continuing work with unprinted repair. The institution works when particular people coordinate material preparation and acknowledge one another's limits. It becomes coercive or unreliable when a desire for food, a claim of rescue, a good intention or an encouraging evaluation is allowed to stand in for that coordination. This is an interpretive mechanism supported by the scenes, not a formal behavioral model or a claim that every School Lunch interaction follows one rule.

Five questions therefore remain distinct throughout the study: was food actually made; did someone want to undertake that work; what could the recipient know and refuse; what was the observed result for this recipient; and what work, damage or obligation was subsequently repaired? GROUP1104 brings oil and willing helpers without printing a finished meal. GROUP1602 passes hygiene criteria before a harmful offered drink and a later F rating. EVENT844 supplies actually eaten and appreciated pancakes after instruction and explicit permission to decline, while time pressure and institutional undervaluation remain. None is a substitute answer to all five questions. Their differences make a richer account than either “School Lunch always fails” or “sincere cooking makes everything care.” [G11 §6; G16 §5; E844 §5.]

The positive ends are intrinsic. Fuuka's soba conversation, amusement, ingredients negotiation, chosen clothes and wishes for peace do not need to improve a military operation to matter. Juri's café pleasure, gardening, trophy, unexpectedly edible parfait, desired service and renewed attempts matter without proving permanent competence. The completed cookie tasting in MINI06020 is valuable as taste and cute making even though captivity closes the encounter badly. A synthesis that retained only coercion or safety failure would erase precisely the ordinary life whose conditions the institution is supposed to support. Pleasant food is an achieved good at its printed extent; it is not evidence that an associated burden has been consented to or repaired. [F-CHK P01/P04; J-CHK R02–R04; MINI §8.]

The institution is also larger than either worker's temperament. Fuuka's competence cannot make four thousand eggs, one pan, absent oil and a two-hour deadline a practicable arrangement merely by moral expectation. Juri's desire to feed people cannot make Fuuka permanently requisitionable, or remove the need to test and inform before serving. Consumers are neither a unanimous audience nor passive measurements: one person accepts boiled eggs, another requests the unwanted serving, another defends the promised menu; some New Year customers welcome a dish others dislike. Thus distributive responsibility includes multiple ordinary tastes and budgets, rather than a single ideal customer whose delight certifies the institution. [G11 1104:u0001–0024; E820 007/014; E844 010:scene003.]

The strongest synthesis is consequently neither a story of inevitable progress nor a permanent pathology. There are actual local revisions: a renewed request after apology, a bounded agreement, a learned cooking accomplishment, a refusal option, a decision to preserve another person's day off. There are repeated failures and contrary acts as well. Those changes can be interpreted within their sequences. Unanchored group, private and miniature stories cannot be placed after a particular apology to manufacture either reform or relapse. The repertoire is coherent through its continuing questions of work and recipient agency even where a global chronology is unavailable.
## 3. Instituted roles and unequal responsibilities

Meal provision makes Fuuka responsible to a timetable and many eaters, without giving every eater authority over her person or every kitchen action. GROUP1601 opens three hours before service. Izumi wants cookies now and offers soup as an alternative; Fuuka insists that lunch must wait for its time. The institutional issue is distribution, not proof that appetite is shameful or that soup is intrinsically unacceptable. Someone who prepares communal food must preserve its availability for other recipients. This locally asserted boundary is practical authority grounded in a task. It is not a complete legal entitlement, and the study does not need one to recognize her refusal as meaningful. [G16 1601:u0001–0028.]

Juri is a working participant rather than an interchangeable deficit in Fuuka's capacity. She helps with capture and calming, knows ingredients and order, wants to teach visitors, values serving, fetches vegetables and asks about potato preparation. Some of those acts are successful and some belong to interrupted or failed cooking. EVENT844's later Fuuka statement that School Lunch cannot operate without Juri recognizes operational dependence; Juri hears both appreciation and a painful implication about her cooking role. Their differentiated labor is therefore visible without pretending that every division is agreed, measured or settled. The institution must preserve the contribution of practical assistance alongside the person's wish to make food herself. [G16 §4; M020 P03; J-CHK R04; E844 010:scene002–003.]

Consumers have their own responsibilities and rights. Izumi's delight in juice does not make her a qualified assessor of its effect on Iori. Haruna's menu complaint can be a legitimate stated expectation while her ensuing kitchen interference disregards the provider's warning. Junko's willingness to help does not guarantee coordinated help. Haruna's useful oil and Akari's appeal to friendship do not resolve who may move what at the stove. Describing these differences avoids giving either cooks or customers a monopoly on the meaning of food. Good taste, promised menus, hunger, preparation conditions and actual recipient safety must be negotiated in the same social space, although they remain different tests. [G11 §6; G16 §5.]

Iori is a substituted evaluator in GROUP1601–1602. Her threatening entrance pressures the workers, while her subsequent checklist response genuinely recognizes the clean hands, equipment, furniture and ingredients presented. The task she states is checking hygiene, not inventing faults. That local fairness matters, and Juri explicitly praises it. It does not establish the full mandate of substituted inspectors or a scientific food-safety audit. The later incident supplies new evidence and a new rating. Institutional authority here is situated and revisable; neither her first menace nor her first praise exhausts it. [G16 1601:u0041–0073;1602:u0001–0059/u0092.]

Helpers and outside employers create another asymmetry. The café manager can praise Juri's service and propose permanent work, which she declines, yet later pressure her to cook after the chef's separate accident despite her stated inability. Offering to bring Fuuka for higher pay does not solve that pressure or authorize it. Juri elects to try partly to protect Fuuka's rest, making the act meaningful without making its conditions uncomplicated freedom. Likewise, a Gourmet rescue project can listen to a proprietor and later ask Fuuka properly while beginning with her capture. The institution's question is who can turn a request into another person's obligation, not whether the requesting actor ever has a generous motive. [E844 001:scene002–004; E820 002/003/012.]

Sensei's role varies. No teacher participates in G16's inspection, so the adults' absence cannot be filled with an imagined regulating lesson. Gift039 shows an invited shared table and gratitude; gift040 shows emotional validation alongside dismissed risk and a harmful local result. EVENT844 includes encouragement of rest, objection to patient treatment and temporary operational command, followed by accepted food after an explicit refusal permission. MAIN shows both confinement and later coalition work. These are different relations to institutional authority; one warm adult encounter cannot make the cooks' labor generally available or resolve another consumer's uninformed position. [G16 §6; gifts039/040; E844 §4/§5; MAIN C002.]
## 4. Resources, labor and actual constraints

GROUP1104 makes resource limits a voiced account, not mere scenery. Fuuka says she cannot fry four thousand eggs alone in two hours; Juri is absent, oil is unavailable and there is one pan. Those quantities and shortages are her reports, not independently audited inventories. Their narrative force is nevertheless clear: a menu expectation meets an arrangement the responsible worker describes as impossible. Haruna anticipates the problem and brings actual oil; the friends volunteer actual help. The ingredients and intentions change, but the institutional relation fails at Fuuka's interrupted warning to ask before touching. This is why resource supplementation cannot be equated with a completed remedy. [G11 1104:u0009–0024.]

The ending is a work outcome in its own right. Oil, eggs, flour, falls and crashes leave the kitchen in disorder and Fuuka silent. Exact intermediate choreography is uncertain; no particular injury, intention to attack or completed restitution should be invented. What is absent is equally specific: no prepared replacement meal, cleanup, apology, cost assessment or repaired work arrangement is printed. Silence supports the interrupted conclusion, not a diagnosis or a permanent attitude to the Society. The act of volunteering may be sincere. Its failure demonstrates how the provider's practical knowledge can be overridden by help that never gives her effective control over its execution. [G11 1104:u0025–0049; §8/§9.]

The club-trial MINI02020 gives a parallel constraint at a different scope. Fuuka discusses dinner preparation and the missing food truck. Juri offers a tour and instruction; curiosity and hospitality are real, but the unusual omelette and retreat interrupt the lesson. Japanese thousands of portions and Korean a few thousand each day remain distinct reported quantities. No repaired truck, completed edible meal, successful training program or general relief follows. This episode matters because teaching is a wanted institutional function, rather than merely spare capacity: visitors and workers have reasons to value learning even when the setting prevents it. [M020 P03; current MINI §3.]

EVENT820 widens resource responsibility from the cafeteria to a threatened restaurant and suppliers. The proprietor describes franchise prices, rent and inherited place; merchants refuse or explain stock; company personnel speak of job dependence and handling food. These are situated testimonies. They support a conflict over material access and livelihoods without an audited contract, stock census or payroll record. Fuuka's demonstrated preparation knowledge and Juri's ingredient interest operate within those constraints. Affordable menu proposals revise Haruna's initial neglect of price, while customers' budgets remain actual local preferences, not a statistical population. [E820 003/004/007–009.]

The contest provides real work and a finite win without a full resource settlement. Fuuka initially objects to forced participation, then Haruna apologizes and asks again; Fuuka agrees. Reported damaged vegetables, meat, bottles and deliveries qualify supply success. Japanese less-than-half usable vegetables differs from Korean about one third. Particular preparations are done—Japanese pickling is complete where Korean drying is current, and shrimp and carrots have their own endpoints. The announced hundred boxes and four hundred servings, as well as Juri's daily-volume figure, remain attributed statements rather than certified output capacity. Announced victory and thanks do not print paid overtime, continued employment, final ownership or every supplier remedy. [E820 012–014.]

EVENT844 likewise refuses a simple equation between accomplishment and relief. A rare day off is interrupted; after several days School Lunch is again preparing food and receives varied household-style complaints. Fuuka states that time and recognition remain insufficient. Juri's actual shared pancakes supply a local success, not a staffing increase or a recovered holiday. Recognition can be necessary without being adequate: appreciation does not itself redistribute work, provide equipment, pay a worker, or complete the time someone lost. The study does not infer that compensation is impossible; it records that these sources do not show it. [E844 001/002/010.]

The military and emergency comparators sharpen this limit. In MAIN C002, Fuuka refuses an impossible three-day whole-school ration demand and plans to slow supply; reported power does not turn infeasibility into competence. In Final C004 E003–004, her pressured driving contributes to an actual arrival. Successful public action demonstrates a particular role, while the argument explicitly preserves the original boarding's lack of retrospective consent. No kitchen capacity, general future vehicle availability or labor settlement follows from the terminal operation's success. These episodes show institutional usefulness under pressure, not the exhaustion of the worker's independent purposes. [MAIN C002 E011–015 checkpoint; Final004:003:u0053–0064/004:u0011–0013.]
## 5. Ordinary wants and private ends

Fuuka's private repertoire constrains an institutional interpretation from within. The produce negotiation ends in buying and returning ingredients; an arrangement for later remains conditional. Soba eating and quiet conversation, clothing nerves, amusement, home accompaniment and wishes for peace are positively represented parts of her life. Her practical care does not require every pleasure to be a recovery technique or an efficiency investment. A provider can want food, time and company as a recipient. The institution's feeding purpose would be impoverished if the cook's own enjoyment were treated as irrelevant whenever it does not change public throughput. [F-CHK P01/P04; F-CMP Q01.]

Her limitations are equally ordinary and meaningful. An invitation can be qualified by fatigue; a not-teasing request and a confidentiality request retain their own authority. A replacement joke is refused; later compliance with secrecy is unprinted. Care improves locally when it asks the recipient's preferences, without becoming a promise of daily service. Written holiday or shop lines remain contextual possibilities, not a calendar of fulfilled outings. Clothes, hair, embarrassment and desired company do not warrant an involuntary public image or a settled romance. They show that chosen presentation and reception belong in the account of a worker who is often treated chiefly as a needed cook. [F-CMP Q03/Q04; F-CHK P03–P06.]

Juri's pleasure is not cancelled by repeated failure. A café order and conversation give enjoyment and recipe curiosity. Her actual contest win, trophy and shared return oppose a blanket incapacity claim; actual eating and appraisal of a parfait oppose the idea that no food she makes ever works. The award is a represented organizer result, not a tested general algorithm or professional ranking. An unexplained successful taste is real without explaining why every other attempt failed. Desire to learn, embarrassment about publicity, customer-violence refusal, a part-time uniform, garden pleasure, particular hand warmth and invitations have value whether or not they produce institutional reform. [J-CHK R02/R03; J-CMP Q01/Q02/Q04.]

Gardening is a modest practical and wanted activity, not a departure from cooking. Juri's supply and budget accounts, sun-care preparation, Fuuka's encouragement and locally useful cultivation broaden what a participant can contribute. The later wait and tentative or withdrawn explanation do not certify illness, a cure, a permanent disappearance or abandoned cooking. Her future weaker-sun invitation remains future. This is a serious contrary case to the assertion that only culinary success can give her a place in School Lunch. It is not sufficient evidence that cultivation solves the club's procurement problem or gives her independent control of its budget. [J-CHK R04/R05; J-CMP Q05.]

EVENT844 turns ordinary choices into the event's first substantive asymmetry: Fuuka values a day free from service, while Juri chooses service because it resembles the happiness of people enjoying her cooking. Fuuka first suggests rest, then supports Juri's different preference; Juri wants Fuuka's free day protected. They do not have to want the same activity to care for one another. A coerced-work-only account would lose Juri's actual choice and skill as a waitress; a work-as-love account would make Fuuka's day off disposable. The sources make both goods intelligible before the accident, and the interruption does not retrospectively make either preference a mistake. [E844 001:scene001–002.]

Gifts039 and040 keep private making and reception distinct from payment for service. Fuuka chooses to bring a meal, accepts shared eating, offers handmade cocoa and receives a narrated warm response. She denies special intention in matched cups; storage, container return and hoped-for sleep are not printed outcomes. Juri's first tasty chocolate is bought, while a handmade batch is withheld because she reports earlier tasters collapsing. The fallback preserves agency and a wish to give without harming. Adult validation and eventual tasting lead to fading consciousness, so emotional appreciation is neither meaningless nor a safety certificate. A gift cannot purchase the giver's subsequent labor or make every recipient objection void. [gift039:u0031–0052; gift040:scene002:u0005–0034; current E810 §6.]

Finally, wanted food is plural. Junko's successful New Year meal, Akari's boiled-egg preference, a visitor's price limit, ordinary menu complaints, Mine's cute-cookie pleasure and Fuuka's desire to help hungry people across schools all matter. They cannot be collapsed into a single superior taste. In MINI06020, food and cute craft achieve pleasure before the final restraint. Keeping that accomplishment and the adverse ending together protects ordinary evidence from both utility reduction and sentimental acquittal. The cook's own stated wish to make cookies is also a reason to postpone another lunch request, not evidence that all cooking can be demanded on the same schedule. [G11 §6; E820 001/007; E844 010; MINI §8.]
## 6. Evaluation, care and safety

G16's ordered inspection is the clearest test of institutional evaluation. Fuuka reports that a previous apparently pleasant inspection led to poor marks and a halved budget. Juri tries to reassure her; a remembered smile does not constitute a favorable report. Iori reports a former inspector's poisoning diagnosis and possible pathogens; those remain reports and possibilities. Fuuka's distinction between poor taste and negligent hygiene is therefore an argument about criteria, not an already established universal safety claim. A frightening entrance can coexist with later evidence-based concession. [G16 1601:u0029–0073.]

The present checks genuinely favor the club. Hands, tools, furniture and ingredients receive favorable marks. Iori's explicit distinction between hygiene and bad taste prevents interpreting the later F as proof that every earlier compliment was dishonest. A moving dish is represented, but Juri's autonomous-selfhood explanation is untested; Iori asks whether that phenomenon belongs under hygiene. The source does not settle ingredient causes, a completed fight or a new person ontology. It instead exposes how a local evaluation domain can omit a risk which the participants do not know how to classify. [G16 1602:u0001–0057.]

Personal hospitality then changes the evidence. Fuuka offers water when Iori is thirsty. Juri provides fresh fruit juice, identified as the same welcome offered to the earlier inspector rather than ordered stock already inspected. Fuuka recalls the earlier diagnosis and tries to stop consumption; Iori has drunk and reacts adversely. Juri calls the unresponsiveness sleep. The sequence strongly supports a source-local explanation of the present incident, while the repeated diagnosis line in Fuuka's realization is not a newly verified medical report. Clinical chemistry, enduring injury and a general pathology remain unestablished. [G16 1602:u0061–0083, attribution table.]

Two contrary reactions must survive: Izumi drinks and enjoys the juice, and Iori later safely awakens and gives an F. Enjoyment is her own positive experience; it does not answer what happened to Iori or prove immunity. Waking is narrated; clinical clearance is absent. The grade is actual; another budget halving is Fuuka's fear rather than printed implementation. These distinctions make evaluation responsive to new evidence without treating every judgment as infallible. They also show why a worker may genuinely protect hygiene and nonetheless contemplate a profoundly inadequate response to a harmed guest. [G16 1602:u0084–0092.]

Fuuka's proposed concealment belongs in the institutional argument precisely because she is ordinarily competent and concerned. Fear of another F and lost funds makes the temptation intelligible; it does not justify withholding a victim or make the proposed removal prudent. The source prints an alarming suggestion and then says no solution worked. It does not print disappearance, killing, successful concealment or a coordinated cover-up. The serious inference is that evaluation pressure can make protecting the institution's apparent standing compete with answering to the affected person. That explanatory relation remains an interpretation of the local sequence, not a diagnosis or proof of an academy-wide incentive mechanism. [G16 §5/§7.]

Private care provides additional limits on success language. Fuuka's eighteen-dish effort has Japanese eating versus Korean tasting all eighteen, an adverse endpoint and an actual prescription; provision, administration, ingestion and cure are not printed. Eel purchase and return differ from later whole-thread testimony about today's dish, preparation and improved stamina. Juri's medicine is contemplated rather than prescribed, and repeated soup attempts leave the final dish unresolved. These cases qualify a competence-only account without equating all Fuuka care with Juri failure. The institutional synthesis uses them to distinguish a made dish, a reported effect, a proposed remedy and a completed recipient result. [F-CHK P02/P03; F-CMP Q05; J-CHK R01; J-CMP Q03.]

EVENT844 supplies an especially important positive countercase. Delicious pancakes and Juri's happiness occur before the dangerous movement, so later harm cannot rewrite the earlier tasting as imaginary. The ending supplies new instruction and practice as reports, followed by explicitly permitted refusal, acceptance and narrated shared eating. This is stronger than another unfinished offer. It supports a bounded accomplishment and affection, while no controlled test of long-term reproducibility or universal harmlessness follows. To preserve both failures and actual good food is a requirement of fair institutional judgment, not a compromise made to protect a likable character. [E844 002:scene001;010:scene003:u0027–0047.]
